deployments_detail.use: AI within Digital Field (Цифровое месторождение) program for oil and gas operations
RN-Seysm proprietary software with ML for seismic interpretation and well-placement planning
Innovative software solutions based on artificial intelligence for technological improvement

AI-equipped drilling data monitoring stations on heavy drilling rigs that analyze real-time drilling telemetry and enable remote support of the drilling process; rolled out across the fleet (Orenburg region and beyond).
deployments_detail.value: AI monitoring stations installed on 97% of heavy drilling rigs

deployments_detail.use: 'LitoText' digital tool based on large language models (LLM) that automatically reads geological core reports and extracts 16 physical core parameters (rock type, fracturing, pore-space type, etc.), checking old records and processing new data. [LLM (Rosneft Tyumen Scientific Institute, in-house)]

'RN-Neural Networks' (РН-Нейросети) software using neural-network technology to select optimal field-development strategies/design decisions, choosing the most economically favorable development scenario for each part of a field. [RN-BashNIPIneft, Izhevsk Oil Research Center (in-house)]

'RN-AvtoBalans' neural-network software that optimizes production/injection well operating modes on mature fields; analyzes dynamics of technological indicators and inter-well relationships, trained on 2019-2025 mechanized-well data. Deployed at the Samotlor field. [Rosneft Tyumen Scientific Institute (in-house)]

AI-based energy-consumption optimization in production: unique algorithms analyze a digital twin of downhole (well) equipment to simulate and select the optimal operating mode, reducing energy use for oil and gas production equipment (patented).

AI 'intelligent assistant' geosteering system that processes data received by the drilling rig in real time and issues recommendations to keep horizontal well trajectories within the target reservoir.
Neural-network algorithm for processing and interpreting seismic exploration data, developed by Rosneft's research institutes to accelerate/improve seismic data processing.

Full-scale field 'digital twins' (automated production-control systems / virtual field replicas) using neural networks for data analysis and production forecasting; operating on assets in Bashkiria and Tyumen and modeled for Sibneftegaz gas fields, being scaled to other subsidiaries.

Neural-network computer-vision system for occupational-safety monitoring at production sites: detects use of personal protective equipment (PPE), identifies personnel, and flags perimeter/safety violations in real time. Tested at Orenburgneft.

'RN-SMT' software that uses AI/neural-network analysis of pipeline operating regimes and conditions to recommend integrity/maintenance work planning per pipeline segment, improving pipeline transport reliability.
Neural network developed by young Rosneft engineers to predict wear/degradation of linear (pipeline) infrastructure, addressing technically complex and time-consuming forecasting tasks.
'Automatic Dispatcher' AI program that monitors technological processes and auto-generates instant operational summaries without third-party services; deployed at the company's Ufa branch.
